defect.summary: run()/fail() wrote the already translated status into the DOM, so the real i18n scanner stored English as the original text and JP-after-EN stayed English.
defect.counterExample: EN start -> successful spherical selection -> switch JP -> next scan keeps 'Spherical region selected.'
defect.rootCause: src/ui/spherical-region-ui.js:63 (review time) used tr() for status.textContent; installLanguage() records nodeValue as source when it differs from the previous output, so the EN output became the source.

change.behavior: Status text is always produced in the Japanese source form and the installed scanner owns translation; the raw failure message is appended untranslated. Only status text nodes changed; aria-label/aria-invalid/aria-errormessage, drafts, focus, spec and selection callback count are untouched.
notChanged: src/i18n.js (no scanner change needed; other UIs unaffected)

success.ja: 球面の数値領域を選択しました。

failure.en: Selection failed. The draft was retained. synthetic selection failure
failure.ja: 選択に失敗しました。入力は保持しています。 synthetic selection failure
failure.note: Only the fixed sentence is translated; the appended raw error text stays raw.

blankRadius.en: Enter every field as a non-blank finite number.
blankRadius.ja: 全ての項目を空欄でない有限の数値で入力してください。

testMethod: tests/ui-spherical-region-scanner.test.mjs imports the real installLanguage() from src/i18n.js and drives its real language-switch handlers. The test supplies only a minimal DOM (text nodes, attributes) and a manual MutationObserver flush; original-text tracking, dictionary lookup and round trips are the production scanner code, not a translation stub.
unverified: Real Chrome: no browser session was used, so the EN->JP->EN status/aria-label at 390 px and by keyboard is not browser-verified; the evidence is Node plus the real scanner path only.
Screen-reader announcement of role=status is unchanged and untested.
